<h2>Allocate Shapley Variance Components</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Allocates unique variance fractions directly and divides shared fractions
equally among their contributing abiotic, association, and spatial
components.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>allocate_shapley_variance_components(data_slice, group_keys)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_slice">data_slice</code></td>
<td>
<p>One grouped variance-fraction data frame.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="group_keys">group_keys</code></td>
<td>
<p>Group keys supplied by [dplyr::group_modify()]. The values are accepted to
preserve the group-modification function contract.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A three-row tibble containing the allocated variance for each component.
</p>

</main>
